# =============================================================
# PRINT VALUE LABELS FROM METADATA FOR ALL STUDY VARIABLES
# =============================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyreadstat

# Load the file and filter to Singapore
df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("ttgintt4.sav", apply_value_formats=False)
df_sgp = df[df["CNTRY"] == "SGP"].copy()

# All variables used in the study (original names before recoding)
study_vars = [
    "T4WLOADT", "TT4G14", "TT4G15", "TT4G16A", "TT4G16B", "TT4G16C", "TT4G16D", "TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F", "TT4G16G", "TT4G16H", "TT4G16I", "TT4G16J", "TT4G01", "T4TYEXPTT",
    "T4TYEXPTS", "TT4G04", "TT4G09", "T4TEMPWH", "T4TNSCH", "TT4G64D", "TT4G64H",
    "TCHWGT", "IDTEACH"
]

print("="*70)
print("VALUE LABELS FROM METADATA (meta.variable_value_labels)")
print("="*70)

for var in study_vars:
    if var in meta.column_names:
        var_label = meta.column_labels[meta.column_names.index(var)]
        val_labels = meta.variable_value_labels.get(var, {})
    else:
        var_label = "NOT FOUND"
        val_labels = {}

    print(f"\n{var}")
    print(f"  Variable label : {var_label}")

    if val_labels:
        print("  Value labels   :")
        for code, lbl in sorted(val_labels.items()):
            print(f"    {code} = {lbl}")
    else:
        print("  Value labels   : (none — continuous variable)")
        # Show range instead
        if var in df_sgp.columns:
            s = df_sgp[var].dropna()
            if not s.empty:
                print(f"  Range          : {s.min():.3f} to {s.max():.3f}")
                print(f"  Mean           : {s.mean():.3f}")

import pandas as pd

# List of categorical variables from your request
cat_vars = ["TT4G14" , # Total Hours (has more than 84 hours - filter it)
            "TT4G15", # Teaching hours
    "TT4G01",    # Gender
    "T4TYEXPTT", # Total experience (grouped)
    "T4TYEXPTS", # Experience at this school (grouped)
    "TT4G04",    # First teaching qualification
    "TT4G09",    # Employment tenure
    "T4TEMPWH",  # Working hours status
    "T4TNSCH",   # Number of schools
    "TT4G64D",   # Collaborative culture
    "TT4G64H"    # Peer reliance
]

for var in cat_vars:
    if var not in df_sgp.columns:
        print(f"\n{var}: NOT FOUND IN DATASET")
        continue

    var_label = meta.column_labels[meta.column_names.index(var)]
    val_dict = meta.variable_value_labels.get(var, {})

    print(f"\n{var} — {var_label}")
    print("-" * 65)

    # Calculate exact counts including NaNs/missing
    counts = df_sgp[var].value_counts(dropna=False).sort_index()

    for code, count in counts.items():
        if pd.isna(code):
            code_str = "NaN"
            meaning = "System Missing (Blank)"
        else:
            code_str = f"{int(code)}" if isinstance(code, (int, float)) and code.is_integer() else f"{code}"
            meaning = val_dict.get(code, "Unlabeled")

        print(f"  Code {code_str:>3} : {count:>5,} teachers  ({meaning})")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create plotting canvas — 2 panels now that the boxplot is dropped
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid' if 'seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid' in plt.style.available else 'default')

# 1. Full Distribution Histogram (Log Scale to view long tail)
sns.histplot(df['TT4G15'].dropna(), kde=False, ax=axes[0], color='skyblue', bins=30)
axes[0].axvline(45, color='orange', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label='Cutoff = 45h')
axes[0].axvline(50, color='red', linestyle='-', linewidth=2, label='Cutoff = 50h')
axes[0].axvline(65, color='blue', linestyle='-', linewidth=2, label='Cutoff = 65h')
axes[0].set_yscale('log')
axes[0].set_title("1. Full Distribution (Log Scale)", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel("Teaching Hours per Week")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Teacher Count (Log Scale)")
axes[0].legend()

# 2. Zoomed-In: 35h to 65h Range
counts = df[(df['TT4G15'] >= 35) & (df['TT4G15'] <= 65)]['TT4G15'].value_counts().reset_index()
counts.columns = ['Hours', 'Count']
counts = counts.sort_values('Hours')

sns.barplot(data=counts, x='Hours', y='Count', ax=axes[1], color='coral')
axes[1].set_title("2. Zoomed-In: 35h to 65h Range", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel("Teaching Hours Code")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Exact Count of Teachers")

for p in axes[1].patches:
    height = p.get_height()
    if height > 0:
        axes[1].annotate(f'{int(height)}',
                         (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., height),
                         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyreadstat
import textwrap

# Load dataset and metadata
df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("ttgintt4.sav", apply_value_formats=False)
df_sgp = df[df["CNTRY"] == "SGP"].copy()

study_vars = [
    "T4WLOADT", "TT4G14", "TT4G15",
    "TT4G16A", "TT4G16B", "TT4G16C", "TT4G16D", "TT4G16E",
    "TT4G16F", "TT4G16G", "TT4G16H", "TT4G16I", "TT4G16J",
    "TT4G01", "T4TYEXPTT", "T4TYEXPTS", "TT4G04", "TT4G09",
    "T4TEMPWH", "T4TNSCH", "TT4G64D", "TT4G64H", "TCHWGT", "IDTEACH"
]

# =============================================================================
# SAMPLE SIZE & WEIGHTED POPULATION SUMMARY (SINGAPORE SUB-SAMPLE)
# =============================================================================

# 1. Unweighted sample size (Number of teacher respondents in SGP)
unweighted_n = len(df_sgp)

# 2. Weighted population size (Estimating total Singapore teacher population)
weighted_N = df_sgp["TCHWGT"].sum() if "TCHWGT" in df_sgp.columns else None

# 3. Number of sampled schools (Clusters)
n_schools = df_sgp["IDSCHOOL"].nunique() if "IDSCHOOL" in df_sgp.columns else None

print("=" * 90)
print("TALIS SINGAPORE SAMPLE SIZE OVERVIEW")
print("=" * 90)
print(f"Unweighted Sample Size (n)   : {unweighted_n:,} teachers")
if weighted_N:
    print(f"Weighted Population Size (N) : {weighted_N:,.2f} teachers")
if n_schools:
    print(f"Number of Sampled Schools    : {n_schools:,} schools")
    print(f"Average Teachers per School  : {unweighted_n / n_schools:.1f}")

# 4. Variable-level sample sizes with multi-line wrapped labels
print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print(f"{'VARIABLE':<12} {'VALID N':<10} {'MISSING N':<10} {'% MISSING':<12} {'FLAG'}")
print("=" * 90)

threshold_1_3rds = unweighted_n * (1 / 3)
LABEL_WIDTH = 70

for var in study_vars:
    # Get metadata label and wrap to multi-line text
    raw_label = (
        meta.column_labels[meta.column_names.index(var)]
        if var in meta.column_names
        else "NOT FOUND"
    )
    wrapped_label = textwrap.wrap(raw_label, width=LABEL_WIDTH)

    # Compute metrics
    valid_n = df_sgp[var].notna().sum() if var in df_sgp.columns else 0
    missing_n = df_sgp[var].isna().sum() if var in df_sgp.columns else unweighted_n
    pct_missing = (missing_n / unweighted_n) * 100
    flag = "Filtered / Rotated (>33.3%)" if missing_n > threshold_1_3rds else ""

    # Line 1: Header metrics + first line of label
    first_label_line = wrapped_label[0] if wrapped_label else ""
    print(f"{var:<12} {valid_n:<10,} {missing_n:<10,} {pct_missing:<11.2f}% {flag}")
    print(f"  └─ Label: {first_label_line}")

    # Lines 2-3+: Subsequent label lines indented below
    if len(wrapped_label) > 1:
        for extra_line in wrapped_label[1:]:
            print(f"            {extra_line}")

    print("-" * 90)

==========================================================================================
TALIS SINGAPORE SAMPLE SIZE OVERVIEW
==========================================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0. DEDUPLICATE COLUMNS FIRST (Fixes DataFrame vs Series bug)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_sgp = df_sgp.loc[:, ~df_sgp.columns.duplicated()].copy()

# Helper function: safely retrieves a single Series
def get_col(df, raw_code, new_name):
    if raw_code in df.columns:
        res = df[raw_code]
    elif new_name in df.columns:
        res = df[new_name]
    else:
        raise KeyError(f"Neither '{raw_code}' nor '{new_name}' found in DataFrame columns.")
    
    # If duplicate columns somehow remain, take the first one as a Series
    if isinstance(res, pd.DataFrame):
        res = res.iloc[:, 0]
    return res

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CLEAN TALIS MISSING CODES FIRST
# ---------------------------------------------------------
talis_codes = [8.0, 9.0, 98.0, 99.0, 9998.0, 9999.0, 999998.0, 999999.0]
df_sgp = df_sgp.replace(talis_codes, np.nan)

# Extract and map series (now guaranteed to be a Series)
gender_clean         = get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G01", "gender").map({1.0: 1, 2.0: 0}) # recoded 1 is female, 0 is male
qual_teacher_clean   = get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G04", "teacher_qualification").map({1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1, 5.0: 1}) # recoded 0 is standard pedagogical certification and 1 is not
multi_school_clean   = get_col(df_sgp, "T4TNSCH", "multi_school").map({0.0: 0, 1.0: 1, 2.0: 1}) # recoded 0 is not working in other school and 1 working in other school
collab_culture_clean = get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G64D", "collab_culture").map({1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1}) # recoded 0 is disagree and 1 is agree
peer_support_clean   = get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G64H", "peer_support").map({1.0: 0, 2.0: 0, 3.0: 1, 4.0: 1}) # recoded 0 is disagree and 1 is agree
contract_type_clean  = get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G09", "contract_type").map({1.0: 0, 2.0: 1, 3.0: 1}) # recoded 0 is permanent and 1 is fixed term
full_time_part_time_clean =  get_col(df_sgp, "TT4G09", "full_time_part_time").map({1.0: 0, 2.0: 1}) # recoded employment status: 1.0 (Full-time) -> 0, 2.0 (Part-time) -> 1

# Drop old raw columns if they exist before renaming to prevent duplicate column creation
cols_to_drop = [c for c in ["TT4G01", "TT4G04", "T4TNSCH", "TT4G64D", "TT4G64H", "TT4G09", "T4TEMPWH"] if c in df_sgp.columns]
df_sgp.drop(columns=cols_to_drop, inplace=True, errors='ignore')

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RENAME RAW TALIS CODES TO DESCRIPTIVE NAMES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
rename_dict = {
    "TT4G16A": "hrs_lesson_planning",
    "TT4G16B": "hrs_teamwork_collaboration",
    "TT4G16C": "hrs_marking_correcting",
    "TT4G16D": "hrs_student_counselling",
    "TT4G16E": "hrs_school_management",
    "TT4G16F": "hrs_general_admin",
    "TT4G16G": "hrs_professional_development",
    "TT4G16H": "hrs_parent_communication",
    "TT4G16I": "hrs_cca_extracurricular",
    "TT4G16J": "hrs_other_tasks",
    "T4TYEXPTT": "teaching_exp_total",
    "T4TYEXPTS": "teaching_exp_current_school",
    "T4WLOADT": "workload_stress",
    "TT4G14": "total_working_hours",
    "TT4G15": "hrs_teaching_per_week",
    "TCHWGT": "sampling_weight",
    "IDTEACH": "teacher_ID"
}

# Apply renaming inplace or create renamed dataframe
df_sgp.rename(columns=rename_dict, inplace=True)

# Assign cleaned recoded values to final dataframe
df_sgp["gender"]                = gender_clean
df_sgp["teacher_qualification"] = qual_teacher_clean
df_sgp["multi_school"]          = multi_school_clean
df_sgp["collab_culture"]        = collab_culture_clean
df_sgp["peer_support"]          = peer_support_clean
df_sgp["contract_type"]         = contract_type_clean
df_sgp["full_time_part_time"]   = full_time_part_time_clean

# Clean any residual duplicate columns one final time
df_sgp = df_sgp.loc[:, ~df_sgp.columns.duplicated()].copy()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE RECODED & LABELED DATASET TO DISK
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_sgp.to_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv", index=False)
print("\nDataset successfully saved to 'talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv'.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. To check the distribution of every task hour variables before capping to 95th percentile
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtask_hour_vars = [
    "hrs_teaching_per_week", "hrs_lesson_planning", "hrs_teamwork_collaboration", "hrs_marking_correcting",
    "hrs_student_counselling", "hrs_school_management", "hrs_general_admin",
    "hrs_professional_development", "hrs_parent_communication", "hrs_cca_extracurricular",
    "hrs_other_tasks"
]

print("=== RAW SUB-TASK DISTRIBUTION (BEFORE CAPPING) ===")

raw_rows = []

for var in subtask_hour_vars:
    if var in df_sgp.columns:
        s = df_sgp[var].dropna()
        raw_rows.append({
            "Variable": var,
            "Valid N": len(s),
            "Min": s.min() if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "p25": round(s.quantile(0.25), 2) if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "Mean": round(s.mean(), 2) if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "p50": round(s.quantile(0.50), 2) if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "p75": round(s.quantile(0.75), 2) if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "p95": round(s.quantile(0.95), 2) if len(s) > 0 else np.nan,
            "Max": s.max() if len(s) > 0 else np.nan
        })

df_raw_check = pd.DataFrame(raw_rows)
print(df_raw_check.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# DIAGNOSTIC: Count NaN / Capped Observations per Task
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtask_hour_vars = [
     "hrs_teaching_per_week", "hrs_lesson_planning", "hrs_teamwork_collaboration", "hrs_marking_correcting",
    "hrs_student_counselling", "hrs_school_management", "hrs_general_admin",
    "hrs_professional_development", "hrs_parent_communication", "hrs_cca_extracurricular",
    "hrs_other_tasks"
]

report_rows = []
total_rows = len(df_sgp)

for var in subtask_hour_vars:
    if var in df_sgp.columns:
        # Original missing count before capping
        initial_na = df_sgp[var].isna().sum()
        
        # Calculate p95 on valid observations
        p95 = df_sgp[var].quantile(0.95)
        
        # Count how many values exceed p95
        capped_count = (df_sgp[var] > p95).sum()
        
        report_rows.append({
            "Variable": var,
            "p95 Threshold": p95,
            "Original NaNs": initial_na,
            "Capped to NaN (Top 5%)": capped_count,
            "Total NaNs After Cap": initial_na + capped_count,
            "Pct Capped (%)": round((capped_count / total_rows) * 100, 2)
        })

df_cap_report = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
print("=== 95TH PERCENTILE CAPPING IMPACT REPORT ===")
print(df_cap_report.to_string(index=False))

    "hrs_student_counselling",

]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Histogram grid — one panel per variable, log scale, p95 marked
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(24, 8))
axes = axes.flatten()

for ax, var in zip(axes, subtask_hour_vars):
    sns.histplot(df_sgp[var].dropna(), bins=30, ax=ax, color="skyblue")
    p95 = df_sgp[var].quantile(0.95)
    ax.axvline(p95, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5, label=f"p95={p95:.1f}")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.set_title(var, fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Exact counts just past p95, for every variable
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for var in subtask_hour_vars:
    p95 = df_sgp[var].quantile(0.95)
    window = df_sgp[(df_sgp[var] >= p95) & (df_sgp[var] <= p95 + 15)][var].value_counts().sort_index()
    print(f"\n=== {var} (p95 = {p95:.1f}) ===")
    print(window)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DEFINE ROTATION MODULE & RECEIPT INDICATOR
# ---------------------------------------------------------
rotation_vars = [
    "workload_stress", "total_working_hours", "hrs_teaching_per_week", "contract_type", "full_time_part_time", 
    "hrs_lesson_planning", "hrs_teamwork_collaboration", "hrs_marking_correcting", "hrs_student_counselling", "hrs_school_management",
    "hrs_general_admin", "hrs_professional_development","hrs_parent_communication","hrs_cca_extracurricular", "hrs_other_tasks"
]

# Ensure rotation variables exist in df_sgp before checking
existing_rot_vars = [v for v in rotation_vars if v in df_sgp.columns]
df_sgp["received_form"] = (~df_sgp[existing_rot_vars].isna().all(axis=1)).astype(int)

print(f"Received rotation form : {df_sgp['received_form'].sum()}")
print(f"Did not receive form   : {(df_sgp['received_form'] == 0).sum()}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. ALIGN COVARIATE NAMES & BALANCE CHECK
# ---------------------------------------------------------
covariates = ["gender", "teacher_qualification", "multi_school", "collab_culture", "peer_support"]

# Verify all covariates exist in df_sgp
missing_covs = [c for c in covariates if c not in df_sgp.columns]
if missing_covs:
    raise KeyError(f"Missing columns in df_sgp: {missing_covs}. Did you run variable mapping?")

# Filter balance frame
df_balance = df_sgp[["received_form"] + covariates].dropna().copy()
print(f"N for balance check (Complete Baseline Covariates): {len(df_balance)}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FIT LOGISTIC REGRESSION BALANCE CHECK
# ---------------------------------------------------------
X = sm.add_constant(df_balance[covariates])
y = df_balance["received_form"]

result = sm.Logit(y, X).fit(disp=False)
print("\n=== LOGISTIC REGRESSION BALANCE MODEL SUMMARY ===")
print(result.summary())

# Likelihood Ratio Test
lr_stat = result.llr
lr_df   = result.df_model
lr_p    = result.llr_pvalue

print(f"\nLikelihood Ratio Test (Joint Significance):")
print(f"  LR statistic : {lr_stat:.3f}")
print(f"  df           : {int(lr_df)}")
print(f"  p-value      : {lr_p:.4f}")

if lr_p > 0.10:
    print("  Result: MCAR supported — covariates do NOT predict rotation module receipt.")
else:
    print("  Result: WARNING — covariates predict rotation module receipt. MAR/MICE is required.")

print("\nIndividual Covariate Odds Ratios & p-values:")
for var in covariates:
    coef = result.params[var]
    or_val = np.exp(coef)
    pval = result.pvalues[var]
    print(f"  {var:<23} OR={or_val:.3f} (coef={coef:+.3f})  p={pval:.4f}")

df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv")

print(f"Loaded analysis sample  |  N = {len(df):,}")

# Non-teaching IVs (Descriptive Column Names)
task_vars = {
    "hrs_lesson_planning": "Planning",
    "hrs_teamwork_collaboration": "Teamwork with colleagues",
    "hrs_marking_correcting": "Marking",
    "hrs_student_counselling": "Student counselling",
    "hrs_school_management": "School management",
    "hrs_general_admin": "General administration",
    "hrs_professional_development": "Professional Development",
    "hrs_parent_communication": "Parent Communication",
    "hrs_cca_extracurricular": "CCA",
    "hrs_other_tasks": "Other tasks",
}

outcome_var = {"workload_stress": "Workload stress"}
weight_col = "sampling_weight"

# =============================================================
# 2. WEIGHTED STATS FUNCTION
# =============================================================
def weighted_stats(df, var, weight_col="sampling_weight"):
    tmp = df[[var, weight_col]].dropna()
    if tmp.empty:
        return None
    x = tmp[var].values
    w = tmp[weight_col].values
    n = len(x)

    wmean = np.average(x, weights=w)
    wsd   = np.sqrt(np.average((x - wmean) ** 2, weights=w))

    df_s = pd.DataFrame({"x": x, "w": w}).sort_values("x")
    cumw = np.cumsum(df_s["w"]) / df_s["w"].sum()
    p25  = np.interp(0.25, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p50  = np.interp(0.50, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p75  = np.interp(0.75, cumw, df_s["x"])
    p95  = np.interp(0.95, cumw, df_s["x"])

    zeros     = int((x == 0).sum())
    zeros_pct = zeros / n * 100

    return {
        "mean": wmean, "sd": wsd,
        "p25": p25, "p50": p50, "p75": p75, "p95": p95,
        "zeros": zeros, "zeros_pct": zeros_pct, "n": n
    }

# =============================================================
# 3. BUILD DATA ROWS
# =============================================================
rows = []

for var, label in task_vars.items():
    s = weighted_stats(df, var, weight_col=weight_col)
    if s is None:
        continue
    rows.append({
        "Variable": label,
        "Mean": round(s["mean"], 1),
        "SD":   round(s["sd"],   1),
        "p25":  round(s["p25"],  1),
        "p50":  round(s["p50"],  1),
        "p75":  round(s["p75"],  1),
        "p95":  round(s["p95"],  1),
        "Zeros (%)": f"{s['zeros_pct']:.1f}",
        "N":    f"{s['n']:,}",
        "_section": "task"
    })

for var, label in outcome_var.items():
    s = weighted_stats(df, var, weight_col=weight_col)
    if s is None:
        continue
    rows.append({
        "Variable": label,
        "Mean": round(s["mean"], 2),
        "SD":   round(s["sd"],   2),
        "p25":  round(s["p25"],  1),
        "p50":  round(s["p50"],  1),
        "p75":  round(s["p75"],  1),
        "p95":  round(s["p95"],  1),
        "Zeros (%)": "—",
        "N":    f"{s['n']:,}",
        "_section": "outcome"
    })

# 4. BUILD EXCEL FILE
# =============================================================
wb = Workbook()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from sklearn.experimental import enable_iterative_imputer
from sklearn.impute import IterativeImputer
import scipy.stats as stats

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Row exclusion for total working hours exceeding 84 hours/week
# ---------------------------------------------------------
n_before_exclusion = len(df_sgp)
df_sgp = df_sgp[df_sgp["total_working_hours"] <= 84].copy()
n_dropped = n_before_exclusion - len(df_sgp)
print(f"Excluded {n_dropped} teachers reporting > 84 total working hours.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Capping the top 5% of each sub-task distribution to NaN (for MICE)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtask_hour_vars = [
    "hrs_teaching_per_week", "hrs_lesson_planning", "hrs_teamwork_collaboration", "hrs_marking_correcting",
    "hrs_student_counselling", "hrs_school_management", "hrs_general_admin",
    "hrs_professional_development", "hrs_parent_communication", "hrs_cca_extracurricular",
    "hrs_other_tasks"
]

for var in subtask_hour_vars:
    if var in df_sgp.columns:
        # Find the 95th percentile threshold based on non-null values
        p95 = df_sgp[var].quantile(0.95)
        # Convert values strictly above the 95th percentile to NaN
        df_sgp.loc[df_sgp[var] > p95, var] = np.nan

# SAVE DATASET TO DISK (Ready for MICE pipeline)
df_sgp.to_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv", index=False)
print("\nDataset successfully saved to 'talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv' with 95th percentile NaN caps applied.")

#running diagnostics
max_teaching_hrs = df_sgp["hrs_teaching_per_week"].max()
print("Max teaching hours after 95th percentile capping:", max_teaching_hrs)
print("Number of columns:", len(df_sgp.columns))

# TRUE MID STEP: Drop rows where Dependent Variable is missing BEFORE MICE
n_dv_missing = df_sgp["workload_stress"].isna().sum()
df_mid = df_sgp[df_sgp["workload_stress"].notna()].copy()
n_after = len(df_mid)

print(f"Starting N:                                 {n_before_exclusion}")
print(f"Rows excluded (DV workload_stress missing): {n_dv_missing}")
print(f"Final Observed-Y Sample N (True MID):       {n_after}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. DEFINE VARIABLE LISTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dep_var = "workload_stress"

# Predictors used in the regression model
indep_vars = [
    "hrs_teaching_per_week", "hrs_lesson_planning", "hrs_teamwork_collaboration", 
    "hrs_marking_correcting", "hrs_student_counselling", "hrs_school_management", 
    "hrs_general_admin", "hrs_professional_development", "hrs_parent_communication", 
    "hrs_cca_extracurricular", "hrs_other_tasks", "gender", "teaching_exp_total", 
    "teaching_exp_current_school",  "teacher_qualification", "full_time_part_time",
    "multi_school", "collab_culture", "peer_support"
]

# Imputation matrix includes outcome + predictors
impute_vars = [dep_var] + indep_vars

# Verify all columns exist in df_mid
missing_cols = [c for c in impute_vars + ["sampling_weight", "teacher_ID"] if c not in df_mid.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise KeyError(f"Columns missing from DataFrame: {missing_cols}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MULTIPLE IMPUTATION WITH VON HIPPEL FMI DYNAMIC ADJUSTMENT
# ---------------------------------------------------------
import numpy as np

df_impute_input = df_mid[impute_vars].to_numpy(copy=True)

# --- STAGE A: Pilot Run (m = 20) to Estimate FMI ---
m_pilot = 20
pilot_q_estimates = []
pilot_u_variances = []

print(f"\nRunning pilot MICE (m = {m_pilot}) to calculate Fraction of Missing Information (FMI)...")

for i in range(m_pilot):
    imputer = IterativeImputer(
        max_iter=10, 
        random_state=100 + i, 
        n_nearest_features=10,
        sample_posterior=True,
        keep_empty_features=True
    )
    imp_array = imputer.fit_transform(df_impute_input)
    df_imp = pd.DataFrame(imp_array, columns=impute_vars, index=df_mid.index)
    
    X = sm.add_constant(df_imp[indep_vars])
    y = df_imp[dep_var]
    weights = df_mid['sampling_weight']
    
    model = sm.WLS(y, X, weights=weights).fit()
    pilot_q_estimates.append(model.params)
    pilot_u_variances.append(model.bse ** 2)

# --- STAGE B: Calculate FMI and Von Hippel's m ---
q_mat_pilot = pd.concat(pilot_q_estimates, axis=1)
u_mat_pilot = pd.concat(pilot_u_variances, axis=1)

Q_bar_p = q_mat_pilot.mean(axis=1)
U_bar_p = u_mat_pilot.mean(axis=1)
B_p = q_mat_pilot.var(axis=1, ddof=1)

total_var_p = U_bar_p + (1 + (1 / m_pilot)) * B_p

# Calculate relative increase in variance due to nonresponse (rIV) and FMI
riv_p = (1 + (1 / m_pilot)) * B_p / U_bar_p
fmi_p = (riv_p + 2 / (df_complete + 3)) / (1 + riv_p)

# Extract max FMI across parameters and apply von Hippel's quadratic rule
max_fmi = fmi_p.max()
m_von_hippel = int(np.ceil(1 + 200 * (max_fmi ** 2)))
m = max(m_von_hippel, 20)  # Floor minimum at 20

print(f"Max Pilot FMI detected: {max_fmi:.4f}")
print(f"Von Hippel's Dynamic Imputation Count (m) set to: {m}")

# --- STAGE C: Final MICE Run using Dynamic m ---
imputed_datasets = []
print(f"\nRunning final MICE across observed outcome sample with m = {m}...")

for i in range(m):
    imputer = IterativeImputer(
        max_iter=10, 
        random_state=200 + i, 
        n_nearest_features=10,
        sample_posterior=True,
        keep_empty_features=True
    )
    
    imp_array = imputer.fit_transform(df_impute_input)
    df_imp = pd.DataFrame(imp_array, columns=impute_vars, index=df_mid.index)
    
    df_imp['sampling_weight'] = df_mid['sampling_weight'].values
    df_imp['teacher_ID'] = df_mid['teacher_ID'].values
    
    imputed_datasets.append(df_imp)

print(f"Successfully generated {m} complete datasets.")
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FIT WEIGHTED REGRESSIONS & POOL VIA RUBIN'S RULES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
q_estimates = []
u_variances = []

for df_m in imputed_datasets:
    X = sm.add_constant(df_m[indep_vars])
    y = df_m[dep_var]
    weights = df_m['sampling_weight']
    
    # Fit Survey-Weighted Least Squares
    model = sm.WLS(y, X, weights=weights).fit()
    
    q_estimates.append(model.params)
    u_variances.append(model.bse ** 2)

# Rubin's Rules Aggregation
Q_bar = pd.concat(q_estimates, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
U_bar = pd.concat(u_variances, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
B = pd.concat(q_estimates, axis=1).var(axis=1, ddof=1)

total_variance = U_bar + (1 + (1 / m)) * B
pooled_se = np.sqrt(total_variance)
t_stat = Q_bar / pooled_se

# Barnard–Rubin adjusted degrees of freedom
df_complete = n_after - len(indep_vars) - 1
lambda_hat = np.clip((1 + 1/m) * B / total_variance, 1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)

df_old = (m - 1) / (lambda_hat ** 2)
df_obs = ((df_complete + 1) / (df_complete + 3)) * df_complete * (1 - lambda_hat)
df_degrees = (df_old * df_obs) / (df_old + df_obs)

p_values = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stat), df=df_degrees))

results_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'Pooled_Coef': Q_bar,
    'Pooled_SE': pooled_se,
    't_stat': t_stat,
    'df': df_degrees,
    'p_val': p_values
})

print("\n=== FINAL POOLED MODEL RESULTS (TRUE MID METHOD) ===")
print(results_table.round(4).to_string(line_width=1000))

# =============================================================
# FIGURES
# =============================================================
%matplotlib inline
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("talis2024_sgp_final_labeled.csv")
print(f"Loaded: N = {len(df):,}")

# Weighted correlation helper
def w_corr(x, y, w):
    w = w / w.sum()
    mx, my = np.sum(w*x), np.sum(w*y)
    cov = np.sum(w*(x-mx)*(y-my))
    sx = np.sqrt(np.sum(w*(x-mx)**2))
    sy = np.sqrt(np.sum(w*(y-my)**2))
    return np.nan if sx==0 or sy==0 else cov/(sx*sy)

w = df["sampling_weight"].values

task_cols = {
    "hrs_teaching_per_week": "Teaching hours",
    "hrs_lesson_planning":          "Planning",
    "hrs_teamwork_collaboration":   "Teamwork",
    "hrs_marking_correcting":       "Marking",
    "hrs_student_counselling":      "Counselling",
    "hrs_school_management":        "School mgmt",
    "hrs_general_admin":            "Administration",
    "hrs_professional_development": "Professional development",
    "hrs_parent_communication":     "Parent communication",
    "hrs_cca_extracurricular":      "CCA",
    "hrs_other_tasks":              "Other tasks",
}
dv = "workload_stress"

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Correlation bar chart ranked by magnitude
# -----------------------------------------------------------
corrs = {}
for col, lbl in task_cols.items():
    tmp = df[[col, dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
    corrs[lbl] = w_corr(tmp[col].values, tmp[dv].values, tmp["sampling_weight"].values)

corrs_sorted = dict(sorted(corrs.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
labels = list(corrs_sorted.keys())
values = list(corrs_sorted.values())
colors = ["#c0392b" if v > 0 else "#2980b9" for v in values]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
bars = ax.barh(labels[::-1], values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
for bar, val in zip(bars, values[::-1]):
    ax.text(val + (0.003 if val >= 0 else -0.003), bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f"{val:+.2f}", va="center", ha="left" if val >= 0 else "right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Weighted Pearson r with workload stress")
ax.set_xlim(-0.20, 0.28)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_correlation_bars.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_correlation_bars.png")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Weighted mean stress by marking hours quartile
# -----------------------------------------------------------
tmp = df[["hrs_marking_correcting", dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
tmp["quartile"] = pd.qcut(tmp["hrs_marking_correcting"], q=4,
                          labels=["Q1\n(0–3h)", "Q2\n(4–5h)", "Q3\n(6–8h)", "Q4\n(9–15h)"])

q_means = tmp.groupby("quartile", observed=True).apply(
    lambda g: np.average(g[dv], weights=g["sampling_weight"])
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.bar(q_means.index.astype(str), q_means.values, color="steelblue", edgecolor="white")
ax.axhline(np.average(tmp[dv], weights=tmp["sampling_weight"]),
           color="darkred", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5,
           label=f"Overall weighted mean (9.77)")
ax.axhline(10, color="navy", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.2, label="International mean (10.0)")
for bar, val in zip(bars, q_means.values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, val + 0.02, f"{val:.2f}",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Marking hours quartile (hours/week)")
ax.set_ylabel("Weighted mean workload stress (T4WLOADT)")
ax.legend()
ax.set_ylim(9.0, 10.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_marking_quartile.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_marking_quartile.png")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Weighted mean stress by CCA hours quartile
# -----------------------------------------------------------
tmp = df[["hrs_cca_extracurricular", dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
tmp["quartile"] = pd.qcut(tmp["hrs_cca_extracurricular"], q=4, duplicates="drop",
                         labels=["Q1\n(0–1h)", "Q2\n(2–3h)", "Q3\n(4h)", "Q4\n(>4h)"])
q_labels = [f"Q{i+1}\n({int(tmp['hrs_cca_extracurricular'].quantile(q))}-"
            f"{int(tmp['hrs_cca_extracurricular'].quantile(q+0.25))}h)"
            for i, q in enumerate([0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75])]

q_means = tmp.groupby("quartile", observed=True).apply(
    lambda g: np.average(g[dv], weights=g["sampling_weight"])
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.bar(range(len(q_means)), q_means.values, color="steelblue", edgecolor="white")
ax.axhline(np.average(tmp[dv], weights=tmp["sampling_weight"]),
           color="darkred", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.5,
           label="Overall weighted mean (9.77)")
ax.axhline(10, color="navy", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.2, label="International mean (10.0)")
for bar, val in zip(bars, q_means.values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, val + 0.02, f"{val:.2f}",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(q_means)))
ax.set_xticklabels(q_means.index.astype(str))
ax.set_xlabel("CCA hours quartile")
ax.set_ylabel("Weighted mean workload stress (T4WLOADT)")
ax.legend()
ax.set_ylim(9.0, 10.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_cca_quartile.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Saved: fig_cca_quartile.png")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Weighted mean stress by admin hours quartile
# -----------------------------------------------------------
tmp = df[["hrs_general_admin", dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
tmp["quartile"] = pd.qcut(tmp["hrs_general_admin"], q=4, duplicates="drop",
                          labels=["Q1\n(0–2h)", "Q2\n(3h)", "Q3\n(4–5h)", "Q4\n(>5h)"])

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE: Scatter plots — marking, other tasks, planning
# -----------------------------------------------------------
top3 = [
    ("hrs_marking_correcting",  "Marking (r = 0.19)"),
    ("hrs_other_tasks",         "Other tasks (r = 0.13)"),
    ("hrs_lesson_planning",     "Planning (r = 0.10)"),
]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))
for ax, (col, lbl) in zip(axes, top3):
    tmp = df[[col, dv, "sampling_weight"]].dropna()
    ax.scatter(tmp[col], tmp[dv],
               s=tmp["sampling_weight"]/tmp["sampling_weight"].max()*20,
               alpha=0.3, color="steelblue", edgecolors="none")
    coeffs = np.polyfit(tmp[col], tmp[dv], 1,
                        w=tmp["sampling_weight"])
    x_line = np.linspace(tmp[col].min(), tmp[col].max(), 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(coeffs, x_line), color="darkred", linewidth=1.5)
    ax.set_title(lbl, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")   # <-- added
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours/week", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel("Workload stress (T4WLOADT)", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
